# BKG name overrides — manually maintained (NOT auto-generated).
#
# LEGACY: production ignores this file. The live site publishes the
# administration-owned roster (docs/JSON-INPUT.md), whose reviewed names
# are authoritative; correct them in bkg-automation instead. Entries here
# apply only to an explicit `scripts/build-roster.py --source sheets` build.
#
# Override the display name a member is shown with, replacing the name that
# comes from the roster Google Sheet. The sheet stays the source of truth; the
# override just wins at build time. This is the text-name counterpart of the
# images/mugshots-override/ directory, and anyone can add or edit entries here.
#
# One entry per line:
#
#     CALLSIGN = Display Name
#
# - Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# - The separator may be '=' or ':'.
# - Callsigns are matched case-insensitively.
# - An entry for a callsign not (yet) in the roster is harmless — it just
#   applies the moment that callsign appears (same as a pre-staged mugshot).
#
# Affects the roster cards, the territory map, the downline tree, and
# members.txt on the next build (scripts/build-roster.py). Overrides appear
# verbatim in members.txt (no "First L" shortening).

KD2MZH = QRS Forrest
KI6SYD = Max P
